records.part: ATEC Water Filtration System for wellhead treatment at Pump Station 347
records.reason: ATEC Water Systems, LLC. (ATEC) is the sole supplier of the ATEC Water Filtration System, the City's preferred product in this region

records.part: Filter media - 42" Pyrolox Media for iron and manganese removal filter vessels
records.reason: The media shall be Pyrolox Advantage.

records.part: Main operating valve on each filter tank, industrial automatic multi-port diaphragm type
records.reason: Main operating valves shall be Bermad IR-4x4-350-P. Substitutions will not be allowed.

records.part: Factory-mounted and wired cycle controller for automatic backwash control
records.reason: The controller to be used is an Alex-Tronic F-25, or similar, which requires a 120 VAC connection

records.part: Fusion bonded epoxy coating for filter vessel immersion service surfaces and manifold immersion surfaces
records.reason: All filter vessel immersion service surfaces and manifold immersion surfaces shall be coated with 3M Corporation ScotchKote 134, a fusion bonded epoxy coating, certified to ANSI/NSF Standard 61

records.part: 3-Way Solenoid Valves used to control water or air that actuates the 3-Way Backwash Control Valves
records.reason: Peter-Paul Model 73 3-Way Solenoid Valves are used to control the water or air that actuates the 3-Way Backwash Control Valves.
